restaurantName: M Bar and Kitchen at Mayfield Villages
address: Mayfield Villages, Heron Place, Colnebank Drive, Watford,WD18 0LQ
bio: M Bar and Kitchen is a new bistro, with a patio and landscaped gardens, located within the Mayfield Villages in Watford.  The traditional Afternoon Tea menu features a selection of sandwiches, including smoked salmon & cream cheese, Coronation chicken and cucumber & mint. Sweet treat include, lemon tart, Genoa cake and profiteroles. Plain and fruit scones are served with jam and clotted cream.  Choose from a selection of tea including Earl Grey, English Breakfast and Chamomile.  Add a glass of Prosecco, Champagne or a cocktail from the bar.  Afternoon Tea is served every day and costs £22.50 per person. 24 hours advance booking is required.
pageTitle: M Bar and Kitchen at Mayfield Villages
